totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your username or email and we'll send you a link to reset your password, if an account exists.
forgotPassword.errorFallback: Something went wrong. Please try again.
forgotPassword.confirmationDescription: If an account exists for that identifier, we've sent a password reset link.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.errorFallback: This link may be invalid or expired. Please request a new one.
resetPassword.successDescription: Your password has been reset. Please log in with your new password.

acceptInvite.title: Set your password
acceptInvite.description: Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
acceptInvite.errorFallback: This invite link may be invalid or expired.
